question: **How was Oliver feeling?**
solution:
The correct anwer is: **Frightened**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Frightened **means to be afraid of a particular person, thing or situation.
 
• The second sentence of the given passage states, *"Oliver was frightened at the sight of so many gentlemen__, which made him tremble and speak in a very low and hesitating voice."*
 
• From here we can conclude that Oliver was frightened.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Bored **means feeling tired and unhappy because something is not interesting or because you have nothing to do.
 
• **Happy **means feeling or showing pleasure; pleased.
 
• **Unconcerned **means not interested in something or not worried about it.
